spec.title: Kamiwaza · Extensions & Platform Operator
spec.description: Are extensions healthy, and is the operator reconciling without errors?

spec.title: Ready
spec.description: Extensions whose Ready condition is True

spec.title: Not ready
spec.description: Extensions whose Ready condition is False

spec.title: Pods running
spec.description: Running extension pods

spec.expr: count((kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="$namespace", phase="Running"} == 1) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) max by (namespace, pod, label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_kamiwaza_ai_extension=~"$extension"})) or vector(0)

spec.title: Pods not running
spec.description: Extension pods Pending, Failed, or Unknown

spec.expr: count((kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="$namespace", phase=~"Pending|Failed|Unknown"} == 1) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) max by (namespace, pod, label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_kamiwaza_ai_extension=~"$extension"})) or vector(0)

spec.title: Warm sandboxes
spec.description: Ready sandboxes across SandboxPools

spec.title: Extension readiness
spec.description: Each Extension's Ready condition over the time range

spec.title: Conditions
spec.description: Every condition the operator reports on the selected Extensions

spec.title: CPU, % of limit
spec.description: Busiest container per extension, as a share of its CPU limit

spec.expr: 100 * max by (label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) ((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", resource="cpu"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) max by (namespace, pod, label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_kamiwaza_ai_extension=~"$extension"}))

spec.title: Memory, % of limit
spec.description: Largest container per extension, as a share of its memory limit

spec.expr: 100 * max by (label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) ((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", resource="memory"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) max by (namespace, pod, label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_kamiwaza_ai_extension=~"$extension"}))

spec.title: Extension logs
spec.description: Log lines from the selected extensions at warning level or above

spec.description: Ready manager replicas of desired

spec.description: Platform roots reporting a blocked condition

spec.description: Reconcile passes per second by controller

spec.title: CPU, % of limit
spec.description: Busiest container per manager, as a share of its CPU limit

spec.expr: 100 * max by (pod) (sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container="manager", pod=~"kamiwaza-platform-operator-.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{container="manager", resource="cpu"}))

spec.title: Memory, % of limit
spec.description: Largest container per manager, as a share of its memory limit

spec.expr: 100 * max by (pod) (sum by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container="manager", pod=~"kamiwaza-platform-operator-.*"}) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{container="manager", resource="memory"}))

spec.title: Operator errors
spec.description: Manager log lines at error or warning level

options.content:
**Are extensions healthy, and is the operator reconciling without errors?**

- **Extensions** reads each Extension's conditions from the operator. Pick one or more with the Extension selector.
- **Platform operator** follows RED: reconcile rate, error ratio, and duration per controller. These panels need the operator's metrics endpoint (`operator-metrics/`) and are hidden until it is on.
